📤 Export Calendar

Export all calendar events to a standard .ICS file. Import this file into Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Outlook, or any other calendar application that supports iCalendar format.

📥 Import Calendar

Import events from a standard .ICS file. Imported events will be created as GeneralEvent-type events in your calendar.

🏢 Building Files

The database can live in separate files: Main.json (office), Wages.json (office only) and one Building-<ID>.json per building. Every device opens all of them and saves only its own. Opened them without Wages.json? Load it by itself with 📂 Load DB and the wages are added to what's open.

🌱 Lots — moves and close-out

A lot moves to another building when its grow log records a room there (or, for a lot with no grow log, when its current room is set to one in the Lot Manager). The building it leaves keeps a copy until the receiving building picks it up, which its device does by itself the next time it opens the files.

Worked out from the dates below: "Cut Clones to Replace Lot" starts the next lot, so it sets when that lot moves into the flower room — and how long each cycle is. Updates as you edit.

Fertilizers are priced per litre. The grow logs record the mL each crop used: in PaperWizard → Configure Sheets, each mL question is linked to its product, by the same name as here. Supplies are used up by each crop (coco blocks, rockwool, clone cubes, trellis…) and are counted below.
Per crop, per plant at the start, or per plant at a task: e.g. coco blocks at Transplanting count the plants the grow log recorded that day (the lowest count of the day), so plants culled before it aren't charged. A lot whose schedule doesn't have the task (Cutting Clones switched off for bought clones) isn't charged for it.
